Definition: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants
BiblicalUsage: Moab = "of his father"; n pr m; 1) a son of Lot by his eldest daughter; 2) the nation descended from the son of Lot; n pr loc; 3) the land inhabited by the descendants of the son of Lot
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
